summary: A checkout's Git and its pull requests on GitHub, as the session's user: tools that reach this machine and, through it, that user's accounts -- a push, a pull request.

tools.name: repo
tools.summary: Git and a GitHub pull request for one named repository: status, diff, log, show and fetch; stage named paths; commit as a named author with no trailer; push the current branch; open, edit or read a pull request and its checks.
tools.description: Scoped local work from the external host: git in root, and gh for a pull request, as this session's user with that user's own credentials. commit takes author as `Name <email>`, who is also the committer; a message carrying a trailer is refused before anything is written, the made commit is read back (its trailers must be empty, its author and committer the named one) and a repository that carries tests/check_commit_attribution.cmake must pass it. push pushes the current branch to the same name on the remote and refuses the default branch. pr-checks answers what `gh pr checks` says, pending and failing included; run-view reads one workflow run, with --log-failed when asked. It never merges, never enables auto-merge, never force-pushes, never rewrites history and never deletes a branch, a file or a pull request.

inputs.name: root
inputs.help: an absolute path to the Git checkout

inputs.name: op
inputs.help: status, diff, log, show, fetch, add, commit, push, pr-create, pr-edit, pr-view, pr-checks or run-view

inputs.name: paths
inputs.help: add: a JSON list of paths, relative to root

inputs.name: message
inputs.help: commit: the whole message; a trailer in it is refused

inputs.name: author
inputs.help: commit: `Name <email>`, the author and the committer

inputs.name: range
inputs.help: diff, log, show: revisions or a range, e.g. origin/main..HEAD

inputs.name: branch
inputs.help: push: the branch the checkout must be on (a guard); empty takes the current one

inputs.name: body
inputs.help: pr-create, pr-edit: the pull request's description, Markdown

inputs.name: base
inputs.help: pr-create: the base branch; empty is the remote's default

inputs.name: pr
inputs.help: pr-edit, pr-view, pr-checks: the pull request's number

inputs.name: log_failed
inputs.help: run-view: the failed steps' logs too

outputs.name: repo.json
outputs.help: each command's argv, exit code, seconds, output size and last lines

requires: git on this machine, and gh signed in for the pull-request operations
tools.example: loom-session run <dir> accounts-machine/repo --name commit-story --input root=<checkout> --input op=commit --input author="A Weaver <weaver@example.org>" --input message="Add the tower defense example"
tools.recovery: Read repo.json and the logs. A refused commit wrote nothing; a made commit that failed its read-back stays made and is named in the failure -- inspect it with op=show before anything is pushed. Nothing is ever pushed by force.
